1.0.2.summary: More ways to organize events, with clearer reporting and release history.

changes.title: Link related events
changes.description: Connect an event to a larger festival or series and show the relationship on supported event pages.

changes.title: Choose an existing venue
changes.description: Select an optional venue from your community when creating or editing an event.

changes.title: Flexible analytics reports
changes.description: Choose a reporting period and chart grouping, then download the current report as PDF, Excel, or CSV.

changes.title: Easier to scan release notes
changes.description: Browse significant changes by release or filter the timeline by update type.

changes.title: Event views in analytics
changes.description: Event charts display recorded views again and explain when no recent activity is available.

changes.title: Reliable event sorting
changes.description: The All Events list preserves and applies the selected sort order.

changes.title: Multi-day schedules save correctly
changes.description: Schedules now accept localized 12-hour time values.

changes.title: Ticket link insights
changes.description: Individual event analytics now show recorded ticket link clicks.

changes.title: Organizer venue access
changes.description: Organizers can manage the venues associated with their own account.

changes.title: Compare events on the dashboard calendar
changes.description: Switch between your events and all events, and spot busier dates by their shading.

changes.title: Dashboard calendar
changes.description: Preview scheduled events by day and browse longer lists of events from the dashboard.

changes.title: Flexible event schedules
changes.description: Choose a single, multi-day, or recurring event. Multi-day events can have different hours each day.

changes.title: Recurring events for organizers
changes.description: Organizer accounts can save recurring events alongside single and multi-day listings.

changes.title: Review duplicate warnings
changes.description: Confirm a separate event directly from its duplicate warning.

changes.title: Support Circle in Messages
changes.description: Reach OpenCircle support from Messages and see when a sent message has been read.

changes.title: Organizer dashboard
changes.description: Organizers land on a dashboard with shortcuts and insights for their own events.

changes.title: Messages and recent activity
changes.description: Message people in your community and see recent content and pending event submissions on the dashboard.

changes.title: Dedicated analytics
changes.description: Find analytics for events, organizers, venues, jobs, and ads in one place.

changes.title: Live ad insights
changes.description: The dashboard shows recorded activity for ads.

changes.title: Bulk event import
changes.description: Import events from a CSV, attach images from a ZIP, and review submissions in the upload workspace.

changes.title: Website job applications
changes.description: Configure application fields and choose multiple employment types for a job posting.

changes.title: Manage ads and review possible duplicates
changes.description: Manage ad listings and get a warning when a new event resembles an existing listing.

changes.title: Venues, jobs, and applicants
changes.description: Manage venue listings, job postings, and applicants from the dashboard.

changes.title: Event traffic sources
changes.description: See where recorded event traffic comes from.
